title: Min Stack
statement:
Design a stack that supports push, pop, top and getMin.
Every operation must run in O(1) time.
hints: What if every plate also carried a sticky note with the smallest value at or below it?
Store pairs: (value, minimum so far). The minimum of the whole stack is on the top pair.
A second stack that only tracks minimums also works.

solution.approach: Push (value, min(value, current minimum)) pairs. Pop removes the pair. top returns the value of the top pair, getMin returns its stored minimum.

analogy: plates that each carry a sticky note with the lightest plate below
